name: Jesters
description: The Jesters were a small but notorious Puerto Rican gang from the Williamsburg area of Brooklyn in the 1950s, known for their fighting prowess and willingness to fight at the drop of a hat. Despite their small numbers, they were feared by rival gangs due to their reputation for toughness.
